Alchemy Jug.name: Alchemy Jug
Alchemy Jug.description: This ceramic jug can produce liquids such as acid, basic poison, beer, honey, mayonnaise, oil, vinegar, fresh water, or wine once per day.

Armblade.name: Armblade
Armblade.description: An armblade is a one-handed melee weapon that attaches to your arm and cannot be disarmed. You can retract or deploy the weapon as a Bonus Action.

Bag of Holding.name: Bag of Holding
Bag of Holding.description: This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions (roughly 2 feet in diameter at the mouth and 4 feet deep). It can hold up to 500 pounds and 64 cubic feet.

Cap of Water Breathing.name: Cap of Water Breathing
Cap of Water Breathing.description: While wearing this cap underwater, you can speak its command word as an action to create a bubble of air around your head that lets you breathe underwater indefinitely.

Clockwork Amulet.name: Clockwork Amulet
Clockwork Amulet.description: When you make an attack roll while wearing this amulet, you can forgo rolling the d20 to treat the roll as a 10. Once used, this property cannot be used again until the next dawn.

Enhanced Defense (+1).name: Enhanced Defense (+1)
Enhanced Defense (+1).description: A creature gains a +1 bonus to Armor Class while wearing this suit of armor or wielding this shield.

Enhanced Weapon (+1).name: Enhanced Weapon (+1)
Enhanced Weapon (+1).description: This magic weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

Goggles of Night.name: Goggles of Night
Goggles of Night.description: While wearing these dark lenses, you have Darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.

Homunculus Servant.name: Homunculus Servant
Homunculus Servant.description: You fashion a faithful mechanical companion out of clay, metal, and wood. In combat, the homunculus obeys your commands and takes its turn immediately after yours.

Mind Sharpener.name: Mind Sharpener
Mind Sharpener.description: The infused item has 4 charges. When the wearer fails a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration on a spell, the wearer can use a Reaction to spend 1 charge and succeed instead.

Prosthetic Limb.name: Prosthetic Limb
Prosthetic Limb.description: This artificial limb replaces a missing appendage. While attached, it functions identically to the body part it was created to replace.

Repeating Shot.name: Repeating Shot
Repeating Shot.description: This magic weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls, ignores the Loading property if it has it, and magically creates its own ammunition if none is loaded.

Returning Weapon.name: Returning Weapon
Returning Weapon.description: This magic weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. Immediately after being thrown in a ranged attack, the weapon flies back to your hand.

Rope of Climbing.name: Rope of Climbing
Rope of Climbing.description: This 60-foot silk rope can hold up to 3,000 pounds. As a Bonus Action, you can command the rope to move up to 50 feet and tie itself off to an object.

Ruby of the War Mage.name: Ruby of the War Mage
Ruby of the War Mage.description: Etched with eldritch runes, this 1-inch ruby attaches to a simple or martial weapon, allowing you to use that weapon as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells.

Sending Stones.name: Sending Stones
Sending Stones.description: A pair of carved smooth stones. While touching one stone, you can cast the Sending spell targeting whoever holds the paired stone.

Wand of Magic Detection.name: Wand of Magic Detection
Wand of Magic Detection.description: This wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast the Detect Magic spell. Regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

Wand of Secrets.name: Wand of Secrets
Wand of Secrets.description: This wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge to locate the nearest secret door or trap within 30 feet.

Wand Sheath.name: Wand Sheath
Wand Sheath.description: This sheath attaches to your arm and cannot be removed against your will. You can insert a wand and draw or retract it as a Bonus Action.

Boots of Elvenkind.name: Boots of Elvenkind
Boots of Elvenkind.description: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound. You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently.

Cloak of Elvenkind.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
Cloak of Elvenkind.description: While you wear this cloak with its hood up, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to see you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

Cloak of the Manta Ray.name: Cloak of the Manta Ray
Cloak of the Manta Ray.description: While wearing this cloak with its hood up, you can breathe underwater and you have a swimming speed of 60 feet.

Eyes of Minute Seeing.name: Eyes of Minute Seeing
Eyes of Minute Seeing.description: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. While looking through them, you have Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks to examine details within 1 foot of you.

Gloves of Thievery.name: Gloves of Thievery
Gloves of Thievery.description: These gloves are invisible while worn. While wearing them, you gain a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks and Dexterity checks made to pick locks.

Helm of Awareness.name: Helm of Awareness
Helm of Awareness.description: While wearing this helmet, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls, and you can't be Surprised as long as you are conscious.

Lantern of Revealing.name: Lantern of Revealing
Lantern of Revealing.description: While lit, this hooded lantern burns for 6 hours on a pint of oil, casting bright light in a 30-foot radius. Invisible creatures and objects are visible as long as they are in the bright light.

Pipes of Haunting.name: Pipes of Haunting
Pipes of Haunting.description: You can play these pipes using a Magic action to expend 1 of its 3 charges. Non-hostile creatures within 30 feet who hear the tune must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or become Frightened for 1 minute.

Pipes of the Sewers.name: Pipes of the Sewers
Pipes of the Sewers.description: You can play these pipes as a Magic action to call up to three swarms of rats. While playing, you can influence the behavior of the swarms.

Radiant Weapon.name: Radiant Weapon
Radiant Weapon.description: This weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls and sheds bright light. As a Reaction after being hit by an attack, you can blind the attacker until the end of its next turn on a failed Constitution save.

Repulsion Shield.name: Repulsion Shield
Repulsion Shield.description: A creature gains a +1 bonus to Armor Class while wielding this shield. As a Reaction after being hit by a melee attack, the wielder can push the attacker up to 15 feet away (4 charges per day).

Resistant Armor.name: Resistant Armor
Resistant Armor.description: While wearing this armor, you have Resistance to one of the following damage types chosen when the armor is infused: Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder.

Ring of Water Walking.name: Ring of Water Walking
Ring of Water Walking.description: While wearing this ring, you can stand on and move across any liquid surface (such as water, acid, mud, snow, or quicksand) as if it were harmless solid ground.

Spell-Refueling Ring.name: Spell-Refueling Ring
Spell-Refueling Ring.description: While wearing this ring, you can use an action to recover one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower. Once used, the ring can't be used again until the next dawn.

Boots of Striding and Springing.name: Boots of Striding and Springing
Boots of Striding and Springing.description: While you wear these boots, your walking speed becomes 30 feet (unless your speed is higher), and you can jump three times the normal distance.

Boots of the Winterlands.name: Boots of the Winterlands
Boots of the Winterlands.description: While wearing these boots, you have Resistance to Cold damage, ignore difficult terrain created by ice or snow, and can tolerate temperatures as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit.

Bracers of Archery.name: Bracers of Archery
Bracers of Archery.description: While wearing these bracers, you have proficiency with longbows and shortbows, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls on ranged attacks made with such bows.

Brooch of Shielding.name: Brooch of Shielding
Brooch of Shielding.description: While wearing this brooch, you have Resistance to Force damage, and you have Immunity to damage from the Magic Missile spell.

Cloak of Protection.name: Cloak of Protection
Cloak of Protection.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

Enhanced Defense (+2).name: Enhanced Defense (+2)
Enhanced Defense (+2).description: A creature gains a +2 bonus to Armor Class while wearing this suit of armor or wielding this shield.

Enhanced Weapon (+2).name: Enhanced Weapon (+2)
Enhanced Weapon (+2).description: This magic weapon grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

Eyes of the Eagle.name: Eyes of the Eagle
Eyes of the Eagle.description: These crystal lenses fit over your eyes. While wearing them, you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

Gauntlets of Ogre Power.name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
Gauntlets of Ogre Power.description: Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is already 19 or higher without them.

Gloves of Missile Snare.name: Gloves of Missile Snare
Gloves of Missile Snare.description: When a ranged weapon attack hits you while you are wearing these gloves, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier.

Gloves of Swimming and Climbing.name: Gloves of Swimming and Climbing
Gloves of Swimming and Climbing.description: While wearing these gloves, climbing and swimming do not cost you extra movement, and you gain a +5 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb or swim.

Hat of Disguise.name: Hat of Disguise
Hat of Disguise.description: While wearing this hat, you can cast the Disguise Self spell from it at will. The spell ends if the hat is removed.

Headband of Intellect.name: Headband of Intellect
Headband of Intellect.description: Your Intelligence score is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Intelligence is already 19 or higher without it.

Helm of Telepathy.name: Helm of Telepathy
Helm of Telepathy.description: While wearing this helmet, you can cast Detect Thoughts at will. As an action while reading a creature's thoughts, you can cast Suggestion on that creature (DC 13).

Medallion of Thoughts.name: Medallion of Thoughts
Medallion of Thoughts.description: This medallion has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can expend 1 charge to cast the Detect Thoughts spell (save DC 13).

Necklace of Adaptation.name: Necklace of Adaptation
Necklace of Adaptation.description: While wearing this necklace, you can breathe normally in any environment, and you have Advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors.

Periapt of Wound Closure.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
Periapt of Wound Closure.description: While wearing this pendant, you stabilize automatically if you are Dying at the start of your turn. Whenever you roll a Hit Die to regain Hit Points, double the number of Hit Points restored.

Pipes of Pain.name: Pipes of Pain
Pipes of Pain.description: You can play these pipes as an action. Each creature within 30 feet that hears you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or take 2d10 psychic damage and be Incapacitated by pain for 1 minute.

Quiver of Ehlonna.name: Quiver of Ehlonna
Quiver of Ehlonna.description: This quiver has three extradimensional compartments that can hold up to sixty arrows, eighteen javelins, and six bows or staves, always weighing only 2 pounds.

Ring of Jumping.name: Ring of Jumping
Ring of Jumping.description: While wearing this ring, you can cast the Jump spell from it as a Bonus Action at will, targeting only yourself.

Ring of Mind Shielding.name: Ring of Mind Shielding
Ring of Mind Shielding.description: While wearing this ring, you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine if you are lying, or know your alignment.

Slippers of Spider Climbing.name: Slippers of Spider Climbing
Slippers of Spider Climbing.description: While you wear these slippers, you have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed, and you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings.

Ventilating Lungs.name: Ventilating Lungs
Ventilating Lungs.description: These metallic lungs attach to your chest. You can breathe normally in any atmosphere and exhale a 20-foot cone of gusting wind or toxic vapor once per day.

Winged Boots.name: Winged Boots
Winged Boots.description: While you wear these boots, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed for up to 4 hours, all at once or in several shorter flights.

Amulet of Health.name: Amulet of Health
Amulet of Health.description: Your Constitution score is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is already 19 or higher without it.

Arcane Propulsion Armor.name: Arcane Propulsion Armor
Arcane Propulsion Armor.description: The wearer's walking speed increases by 5 feet. The armor includes gauntlet rocket fists that deal 1d8 Force damage (melee or thrown 20/60 ft), and the wearer cannot be knocked Prone against their will.

Belt of Hill Giant Strength.name: Belt of Hill Giant Strength
Belt of Hill Giant Strength.description: While wearing this belt, your Strength score is 21. It has no effect on you if your Strength is already 21 or higher without it.

Boots of Levitation.name: Boots of Levitation
Boots of Levitation.description: While you wear these boots, you can cast Levitate on yourself at will as a Magic action.

Boots of Speed.name: Boots of Speed
Boots of Speed.description: While you wear these boots, you can click the heels together as a Bonus Action to double your walking speed and give attackers Disadvantage on opportunity attacks against you for 10 minutes.

Bracers of Defense.name: Bracers of Defense
Bracers of Defense.description: While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class if you are wearing no armor and using no shield.

Cloak of the Bat.name: Cloak of the Bat
Cloak of the Bat.description: While wearing this cloak, you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. In Dim Light or Darkness, you can grip the edges of the cloak to fly with a speed of 40 feet or transform into a Bat.

Dimensional Shackles.name: Dimensional Shackles
Dimensional Shackles.description: You can take a Magic action to shackle an Incapacitated creature. The shackles prevent the creature from using any form of extradimensional movement, teleportation, or planar travel.

Gem of Seeing.name: Gem of Seeing
Gem of Seeing.description: This gem has 3 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge to gain Truesight out to 120 feet for 10 minutes.

Horn of Blasting.name: Horn of Blasting
Horn of Blasting.description: You can use an action to blow this horn, emitting a 30-foot cone of sound. Each creature in the cone must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or take 5d6 Thunder damage and be Deafened for 1 minute.

Ring of Free Action.name: Ring of Free Action
Ring of Free Action.description: While you wear this ring, difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement. In addition, magic can neither reduce your speed nor cause you to be Paralyzed or Restrained.

Ring of Protection.name: Ring of Protection
Ring of Protection.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while wearing this ring.

Ring of the Ram.name: Ring of the Ram
Ring of the Ram.description: This ring has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can expend 1 to 3 charges as an action to strike a creature within 60 feet with a ghostly ram, dealing 2d10 to 6d10 Force damage and pushing it up to 20 feet.
